root_cause: Postgres pg_get_functiondef returned a PL/pgSQL DDL source with final $function$ but no SQL statement terminator. Pasting followed by explicit fail-closed REVOKE led to SQLSTATE 42601 at REVOKE and prevented all media-preservation schema deployment.
prevention: When composing SQL migrations from pg_get_functiondef, explicitly terminate the complete CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION statement with a semicolon before independent GRANT or REVOKE.
Keep SECURITY DEFINER execution revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and limited to service_role.
Never bypass protected GitHub status checks or declare media/published state until exact source parity and provider-backed proof.
Require the canonical SQL migration apply and proof of retained pre-existing VERIFYING video manifest after idempotent daily ensure.

evidence.sql_error: syntax error at or near REVOKE

production_claim: Requires protected CI, migration applied successfully, exact production function definition and privileges verified and media-job proof.
